source.check: returned unopposed: no more nominations than seats; 'there will be contests in three of the six wards—North, West and West Central' and the West Ward councillors are marked '(no contest)' (Larne Times, 4 May 1961, p. 9, image-read)

note: Municipal elections, 17 May 1961: one alderman and two councillors for each of the six wards. Twenty-five nominations; contests in North Ward (alderman and councillors), West Ward (alderman) and West Central (alderman and councillors) (Belfast News-Letter, 18 May 1961); all other seats were returned unopposed (Larne Times, 4 May 1961, p. 9, which prints every nomination). No party labels are printed for the unopposed members. Returned unopposed.
